temperature_policy: Each load starts when GPU is P8, utilization 0%, and reported temperature is 30-32 C. Automatic fan and power policies are not changed. Temperature equality alone does not guarantee identical heatsink/ambient temperature.
comparison_scope: Three new independent runs; previous single run retained only for context; Quarch power is not calibrated against NVIDIA telemetry.
temperature_target_selection: Preparation allowed natural cooling from 49 C to 31 C. Selected 31 +/- 1 C before starting any of the three repetitions.
